buckets.quarantineNotice.body: About quarantine buckets: *-quarantine buckets are system areas that temporarily store user-uploaded files during verification. Successful uploads are automatically moved to the original bucket, leaving these buckets empty, but objects may remain if verification fails, is canceled, or is interrupted. You can delete them manually if needed.
buckets.trashNotice.body: About trash: Deleted files are stored in *-trash buckets, and deleted buckets are hidden from the list and retained for {retentionDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. They can be restored during the retention period and are automatically deleted permanently when it expires. Items in trash also use storage space.
